title: Android Backup Receipt
user: Android owners moving phones or relying on self-hosted backup who need to know which local photos, files, and app-export folders are actually recoverable.

evidence.quote_or_summary: Ask HN simply asks how people back up Android; it drew 82 comments, indicating no obvious trusted default workflow.
Nextcloud Android's Auto Upload issue has 122 comments and 90 reactions around a local file no longer being found.

smallest_useful_product: Android app that inventories chosen SAF folders, computes a privacy-preserving manifest, compares it with an attached USB/WebDAV/S3 destination, and produces a dated restore receipt with missing/changed counts.
constraints: Use Android Storage Access Framework only; never claim full-device backup; hash efficiently under battery limits; encrypt destination credentials; disclose media metadata handling.
